jobs.description:
Are you a night owl with a talent for solving technical challenges?

Do you thrive in a modern production environment where teamwork and quality are top priorities? Then this is the opportunity for you!

Your role

As a Maintenance Technician in the fixed night shift, you are essential to our production process. You ensure that machines operate at their best, perform preventive maintenance, and resolve malfunctions quickly and effectively. With your technical skills and problem-solving mindset, you keep the production running even while the world sleeps.

What will you do?

• Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on machines and installations.
• Detect, analyze, and fix malfunctions (primarily electrical, ideally with mechanical expertise).
• Start up and optimize production lines.
• Actively contribute to improving the reliability and efficiency of the equipment.
• Collaborate with a team and report to the technical service manager.
Work schedule

• 2 workdays (2 x 7.36 hours) and 2 weekend days (2 x 11 hours), offering a steady yet varied schedule.
 

 

• A technical degree or relevant experience in a production environment.
• Broad technical knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and pneumatics; PLC knowledge is a plus.
• A flexible, positive attitude and strong problem-solving skills.
• A team player who is eager to learn and improve.
• Fluency in Dutch or English.

As a Line Supervisor 2-shifts, you are the key figure in the packaging department. You lead a motivated team and ensure that the machines perform optimally and the final products leave the facility perfectly packaged. You work closely with the production manager and planning department in a clean, high-tech, and fast-paced work environment where no two days are the same.

In the role of Line Supervisor 2-shifts, you carry the responsibility for the entire packaging process. Your concrete tasks include:

• Process Monitoring: You correctly start up and guide the packaging process from A to Z to guarantee an efficient flow.
• Team Leadership: You coordinate, motivate, and guide the team on the packaging floor.
• Quality & Hygiene: You ensure strict compliance with quality standards and hygiene regulations within the food sector.
• Problem Solving: You quickly resolve operational issues and malfunctions, and continuously look for process optimizations.
• Reporting: You report directly to the production manager regarding progress, results, and any bottlenecks.
• Communication & Planning: You check packaging orders and streamline communication between production planning and the storage of the finished product.
• Digitalization: You assist with the further rollout and everyday use of the MES & ERP systems on the packaging floor.
To be successful as a Line Supervisor 2-shifts or experienced packaging team leader, you recognize yourself in the following profile:

• Experience: You have experience within a production environment, ideally in the food industry.
• Leadership & Insight: You have technical insight and possess the natural ability to manage and motivate an operational team.
• Flexibility: You are a real go-getter with a flexible mindset who is happy to work in a fixed 2-shift system.
• Communication: You have a good command of the English language (for communication on the work floor).
• IT Skills: You have good computer skills and quickly pick up new software (such as ERP or MES).

As a future butcher / deboner of pork meat, you will work on different lines with tasks such as cutting shoulders, bellies, and ribs. 

Experience is an asset, but motivated newcomers are welcome. 

Thanks to the Butchers Academy, you will receive comprehensive training, followed by a permanent contract and annual evaluations offering opportunities for advancement.

We are looking for ambitious and eager-to-learn individuals who can start early (start at 4.55 AM) and are flexible in their schedules depending on the season. 

You should be comfortable working in a cold environment and have an affinity for the food industry (pork meat), along with the associated quality and hygiene standards. 

You must be physically capable of standing and working all day and place importance on workplace safety. 

Language is not a barrier; everyone has equal opportunities, whether you speak English, French, or Dutch.

For our client, a company in Lokeren specialized in the assembly of car seats and a supplier to Volvo Trucks, we are looking for an 
Assembly Worker.
 

What will you do?
 
 

• You will be responsible for assembling car seats on the production line. 

• You will make sure that your part of the assembly process is completed accurately and to a high standard. 

• You will regularly switch workstations and work closely with your colleagues. 
 

• You already have experience as an 
assembly or production worker. 

• You are willing and able to work in 
2 shifts in Lokeren.  

• You are comfortable with physical work, as some components can be quite heavy.. 

• You speak and understand 
English well.

What will you do?

What does your day look like as a truck driver with a Moffett?

  • You start early in the morning (between 5 AM and 6 AM) from our base in Deinze. Loading is not necessary – your truck is already prepared the night before. You follow a fixed route for a regular customer. On average, you make 4 to 6 deliveries per day across the Benelux.
  • You are responsible for unloading the goods yourself using the Moffett forklift attached to your truck. Our dispatch team is always ready to support you in case of questions, delays, or unexpected situations.
  • Finished with your deliveries? Then you drive back to Deinze – job done!

Interested?
Send your CV to Eeklo@absolutejobs.be

What do we expect from you?

  • You're not afraid to roll up your sleeves and get things done
  • Physical work is part of the job for you – not an obstacle
  • You have your own transportation, as the truck stays on our premises
  • You can communicate fluently in Dutch, French, or English
  • You're a team player who’s ready to help out where needed
  • You keep your truck and trailer clean and tidy
  • You maintain clear communication with dispatch and other departments

jobs.occupation: Talencia Consulting - SAP FICO Functional Analyst
jobs.description:
Talencia is looking for a SAP FICO Functional Analyst for one of its clients.

Location : Brussels periphery

Start date : ASAP

Duration : Permanent (Open-Ended Contract, CDI)

Our client is a well-established retail organization looking for a SAP FICO Functional Analyst to join its internal team and take an active role in the day-to-day management and evolution of their SAP landscape.
Description 

• Act as a functional reference for SAP, with a strong focus on FICO.

• Provide day-to-day functional support and analyse incidents and business requirements.

• Translate business needs into functional SAP solutions and specifications.

• Understand end-to-end processes including purchasing, order flows, warehouse operations and Finance.

• Analyse interactions between SAP and external applications, interfaces and third-party systems.

• Work closely with developers and technical teams, understanding technical specifications and code without being a developer yourself.

• Participate in functional analysis, testing and implementation of new solutions.

• Gradually take ownership of existing knowledge through close collaboration and knowledge transfer from experienced SAP professionals.

You are a SAP professional with a strong functional mindset, capable of understanding both business processes and their technical environment. Along, you bring:

• 5+ years of SAP experience.

• Strong knowledge of SAP FICO.

• Experience as a SAP Functional Analyst, SAP Business Analyst, SAP Consultant, Application Consultant or similar.

• A good understanding of end-to-end SAP processes and integrations.

• The ability to turn business requirements into practical functional solutions.

• Enough technical understanding to communicate effectively with developers and understand interfaces and system interactions.

• A working knowledge of English, Dutch and French

You will support the Customer Service team with tasks such as order entry, stock assignment, requests of certificates, etc.

 As you will progress in your training, the responsibilities can be expanded to direct customer support and coordination of the full order to cash process for a selected amount of customers.

• Act as a key point of contact for assigned customers and provide professional and timely support.

• Manage the end-to-end order process, including order entry, verification, delivery coordination and invoicing.

• Maintain accurate customer and order information in the systems.

• Provide customers and Sales colleagues with clear updates on order and delivery status.

• Prepare relevant documentation, including order confirmations, delivery documents and certificates.

• Respond to customer inquiries and help resolve order, delivery, pricing or product-related questions.

• Work closely with Sales and internal stakeholders to ensure an efficient customer experience.

WE’RE HIRING!
 

We recruit a motivated sales advisor who sees a challenge in the following responsibilities and focal points:

You will work in Ninove, in a modern and highly automated environment specialized in logistics automation and automated warehouse systems.

The company develops, integrates and maintains automation solutions that help warehouses, production environments and distribution centers operate more efficiently.

Jobomschrijving

For an internationally active company specialized in automated warehouse systems and logistics automation, we are looking for an experienced and motivated Automation Technician / PLC Technician to join the permanent night shift team.

You will ensure that highly automated warehouse and logistics systems continue to operate efficiently and reliably.

As an Automation Technician, you will be responsible for the maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of automated installations.

Your responsibilities:
	
• Performing preventive and corrective maintenance on complex automated installations.	
• Diagnosing and resolving technical faults and breakdowns.	
• Troubleshooting issues in electrical, mechanical and automated systems.	
• Working with PLC controls, sensors, motors and SCADA systems.	
• Ensuring that automated warehouse installations operate safely and efficiently.	
• Carrying out technical interventions independently and identifying the root cause of malfunctions.	
• Recording maintenance activities and interventions correctly in the CMMS system (Sprocket).	
• Working independently during the permanent night shift, while consulting colleagues when necessary.	
• Contributing to the safety, reliability and efficiency of the installations.

	
• A technical degree in electromechanics, electricity, automation and/or mechanics.	
• Several years of experience as an Automation Technician, Maintenance Technician, Service Technician, Troubleshooting Technician or PLC Technician.	
• Basic knowledge of industrial automation and PLC systems.	
• Knowledge of sensors, motors, electrical components and technical installations.	
• Experience with or an interest in SCADA and CMMS systems.	
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.	
• A proactive, independent and accurate working attitude.	
• A good command of Dutch and/or English.	
• No fear of heights, as you may work at different levels within the automated installations.	
• Good physical fitness.	
• A strong interest in technology and a willingness to continue learning.	
• The flexibility and motivation to work in 2 shifts

WE’RE HIRING!
 

The store manager is responsible for the daily direction of the store, in order to become a profitable store, within the predetermined budgets.
 

The job of the store manager includes, but is not limited to, these following important tasks:
 

 
 

Analysis of the shop performance
 
 

• You do everything to reach the sales plans.

Client Service
 
 

• You apply the obligated sales standards and you use up-to-date technical product knowledge to increase the sales. You ensure that this is also applied by the store personnel.

Personnel Management
 
 

• You coach, train, motivate and develop the team in order to reach the goals.

• You follow-up the accomplishments of the team very well and you make sure that the rules are being followed.  

Stock

Operations
 
 

• You are responsible for an accurate and a trustworthy compliance of the daily procedures (money and banking, shop opening and closing, health and safety, etc.). 

• You ensure that the repairs are being followed-up professionally and accurately.  

Merchandising, Marketing & Promotions
 
 

• You take care of the shop and window presentation and lay-out in accordance with the defined standards. 

• You take care of a full preparation and implementation of promotions and the correct use of promotion materials. 

We expect a store manager to:
 
 

• Have a previous experience as a store manager in a high-level brand retail environment. 

• Have good organizational, managerial, coaching and communicative skills. 

• Be flexible and be able to work weekends. 

• Communicate in a clear, concise and understandable way and to listen to others. 

• Be very client-oriented. 

• Communicate fluently in Dutch and English. 

• Be able to influence, take decisions and responsibility in a rapidly evolving and changing environment. 

• Be stress resistant. 

• Be informed on new market trends, client wishes and the competition. 

• Act as an ambassador of the company, who lives by the values and shows passion for the brand.

• Network infrastructure

• Azure

Nice to have:

jobs.occupation: Senior R&D Specialist - Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy
jobs.description:
About you and this role
 

At Dow, our Analytical Science organization plays a critical role in accelerating innovation, supporting manufacturing excellence, and solving complex technical challenges across our global businesses.
 

The Analytical Science team in Seneffe is a key part of this global network, providing world-class analytical expertise to support research, product development, process optimization, and customer-focused innovation. Leveraging advanced analytical technologies and deep scientific knowledge, the team partners closely with R&D, manufacturing, and commercial organizations to deliver impactful solutions across a broad range of material science applications.
 

We now have an exciting opportunity for a 
Senior R&D Specialist – Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy to join our Analytical Science division in 
Seneffe, Belgium.
 

In this role, you will apply advanced analytical techniques to solve complex challenges in industrial chemistry and materials science. Working closely with global R&D, manufacturing, and business teams, you will provide critical insights that support product development, process optimization, manufacturing excellence, and customer-focused innovation.
 

As a subject matter expert in Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectroscopy, you will lead analytical investigations, develop new measurement methodologies in a world class NMR lab with global resources, and enhance existing analytical capabilities. This role offers the opportunity to collaborate across a diverse global network while supporting multiple high-impact projects simultaneously.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Lead analytical investigations to resolve complex technical, product, and manufacturing challenges. 

• Develop, optimize, and implement advanced NMR methodologies to expand analytical capabilities. 

• Manage and maintain state of the art NMR instrumentation including cryoprobe technology. 

• Interpret complex analytical data and provide technical leadership on projects involving materials characterization, process optimization, and product performance. 

• Drive innovation through the application of advanced analytical techniques and scientific problem solving. 

• Share technical expertise, mentor colleagues, and contribute to capability building within the Analytical Sciences community. 

• Ensure delivery of high-quality analytical results while managing multiple priorities and project timelines.  

Qualifications
 
 

• Ph.D. in Analytical Chemistry, Polymer Science, Materials Science, Biochemistry, Physics, Chemical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline. 

• Demonstrated expertise in Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectroscopy including method development and advanced applications, for example in multidimensional solution-state NMR, pulse programming, solid-state NMR, and/or DNP-NMR. 

• Strong knowledge in at least two of the following areas: analytical chemistry, polymer science, organic chemistry, materials science, coatings or formulation science, chemical processing, polymer characterization, or statistics/data analysis. 

• Proven track record of applying analytical science to solve complex technical challenges. 

• Experience supporting research, product development, manufacturing, or process optimization programs. 

• Fluency in English, both written and verbal. 

• Additional language skills, preferable French, Dutch, Italian, Spanish or German are an advantage.  

Additional Notes
 
 

• This position does not offer relocation assistance 

• Please submit your application in English to be eligible for consideration in the selection process.  

 

Benefits – What Dow offers you
 

We invest in you.
 

Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
 

Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:
 
 

• Equitable and market-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives. 

• Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it. 

• Competitive retirement program that may include company-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial-goals. 
 

• Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).   

• Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only). 
 

• Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.   

• Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations. 

• Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building. 

• Workplace culture empowering role-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs. 

• Competitive yearly vacation allowance. 

• Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents). 

• Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured. 

• Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation. 

• Wellbeing Portal for all Dow employees, our one-stop shop to promote wellbeing, empowering employees to take ownership of their entire wellbeing journey. 

• On-site fitness facilities to help stay healthy and active (availability varies depending on location). 

• Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more. 

• Additionally, some of our locations might offer: 
 

• Transportation allowance (availability varies depending on location) 

• Meal subsidiaries/vouchers (availability varies depending on location) 

• Carbon-neutral transportation incentives e.g. bike to work (availability varies depending on location)    

Join our team, we can make a difference together.
